name: episode_id
description: Episode this row belongs to; ep_<sha256(ref)[:16]> for trigger-born episodes

name: payload_json
description: Observation payload (DLP-scrubbed); may be a JSON string literal when the stored bytes were not parseable

name: sig_verified
description: 1 = HMAC evidence-envelope signature verified at recording time

name: exported_at
description: Snapshot upload time (microsecond precision); the *_latest views key on it

name: export_phase
description: ladder_complete (final verdict recorded) | outcome_final (re-export after ground-truth labeling)

name: export_session
description: Harness session that ran the export
